sections.title: Specifying Alternative Consequences
sections.content: To introduce what would have occurred had circumstances been otherwise, Hungarian uses *máskülönben* (otherwise), *ellenkező esetben* (in the contrary case), or *másként* (differently), frequently paired with *volna*.

items.spanish: Szerencsére siettünk, máskülönben lekéstük volna a vonatot.
items.english: Fortunately we hurried; otherwise, we would have missed the train.

items.spanish: Be kellett avatkozniuk, ellenkező esetben katasztrófa történt volna.
items.english: They had to intervene; in the opposite case, a catastrophe would have occurred.

items.spanish: Ha másként döntöttünk volna, ma teljesen máshol tartanánk.
items.english: If we had decided differently, we would be in a completely different place today.
